Color Win Website

/
Local access: website server aur YouPI services chalni chahiye. VS Code mein Run and Debug → Color Win - Preview → F5 se website server start karein. Har panel ka apna access key/login hai; yeh hub login ko bypass nahi karta. Phone-pairing QR sirf isi PC par kholen aur kisi ko forward na karein.
